_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. aggroRadius 1.0 is the pre-merge zone radius verbatim and IS the interaction range (D7 ⇒ interaction.range omitted). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The support-line teacher: FirstAid early, Revive much later.
name: VillageHealer

lines: Rest by the fire and regain your strength.

options.blockedLine: I see you have a long way ahead of you. But I also see much potential. Come back later.

grants.line: You are hurt. Here — learn to patch yourself up, you will need it out there.
Let me teach you how to aid your fallen comrades and bring them back to life.
